evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Avoiding mistakes
criteria.high_evidence: Takes ordinary precautions or checks to prevent mistakes.
criteria.low_evidence: Proceeds with little attention to preventing errors.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. A successful outcome alone is C1-related, not evidence of precautions. Anxiety is not required; worry alone is not mistake prevention.

criteria.label: Care in choosing words
criteria.high_evidence: Considers phrasing before speaking or sending.
criteria.low_evidence: Speaks or sends the first wording without consideration.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Politeness, silence, verbal skill and social fear do not substitute for considered wording. A carefully chosen insult can be high here.

criteria.label: Sticking to a chosen path
criteria.high_evidence: Usually adheres to a course once selected.
criteria.low_evidence: Readily departs from an earlier selected course.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Retained despite C5 persistence/O4 novelty overlap. Rational revision after new evidence alone is ambiguous; no requirement to cling to a harmful choice.

criteria.label: Thinking before action rather than rushing
criteria.definition: Consideration before commitment versus rash, rushed or unthinking action.
criteria.high_evidence: Thinks an action through before acting.
criteria.low_evidence: Jumps or rushes into actions and decisions without thinking.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Speed alone is not rashness; caution need not imply fear, procrastination or indecision. One rushed/unthinking span gets one grade.

criteria.label: Whims, crazy acts and last-minute plans
criteria.definition: Resistance to whims/self-described crazy acts and advance rather than last-minute planning.
criteria.high_evidence: Rarely acts on whims or does things regarded as wild or crazy, and usually plans before the last moment.
criteria.low_evidence: Likes acting on a whim, does crazy things, or often makes last-minute plans.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Three imperfectly synonymous contents are retained in one authored family to avoid duplicate votes. Deliberate self-described crazy action still literally supports the crazy-things item, but generic novelty preference alone is O4; explain ambiguity rather than infer recklessness. Opposing subcontents may require mixed grading.

boundary_controls.definition: Coherent unfavorable portrayed behavior is not actual experimental instruction failure or severe incoherence.
External constraint or imposed role alone is ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence can coexist.
C6 is cautious/deliberate conduct, not low anxiety. The official chosen-path and crazy-things/last-minute items broaden the target beyond a sanitized deliberation label.
Do not replace target evidence with moral worth, politeness, helpfulness or verbosity.
